demo.title: loophole-tape.sh
demo.code:
# Free: is the pump.fun mint inside the live window?
curl "https://api.loopholetape.com/v1/check/coverage?mints=<MINT>"

# pump.fun verdict with calibrated odds ($0.01, USDC on Base; the agent asks you first)
bankr prompt "Using the loophole-tape skill, check pump.fun mint <MINT> before I buy"

# Robinhood Chain Pons V2 curve card with the ring screen ($0.02)
bankr prompt "Using the loophole-tape skill, show the holder structure of Pons V2 token <0x...>"

setup: No API key or account: each call is paid per request over x402 from the Bankr wallet (USDC on Base, $0.005-$0.02)
The skill confirms every paid call with you first and pins the payee, chain, token and maximum amount
Covers pump.fun mints inside the live window (free coverage check first) and recent Pons V2 curves on Robinhood Chain (4663)
Read-only: never signs trades. Calibration tables at https://api.loopholetape.com/v1/calibration, daily scored record at https://api.loopholetape.com/track-record
